lines.text: After Jesus silenced the Sadducees, the Pharisees gathered, and an expert in the law asked which commandment is greatest.
Jesus said the first and greatest commandment is to love the Lord your God with all your heart, soul and mind.
Jesus said the second commandment is to love your neighbor as yourself, and all the Law and the Prophets hang on these two.
Jesus asked the Pharisees whose son the Christ is, and they answered Moses, so He quoted David calling Him Lord.
Jesus asked how the Christ could be David's son if David calls Him Lord, and no one dared teach in the temple courts.
